frontend: retro-run (writes saves as RetroArch does), via work/c64/make-save-x.py: content copied into the run directory; runner work/msx/retro-run-x (retro-run plus raw keycodes and --keep-temp)
note: VICE writes the save disk as <content stem>.save0.d64 in the save directory (the M3U #SAVEDISK mechanism, here through the Toggle Save Disk hotkey, which is unmapped by default and set to F12 here) and stores it gzip-compressed on unload, hence .save0.d64.gz. The game ran from the No-Intro PP .nib (VICE converts it to <savedir>/TEMP/<name>.g64 and deletes that at deinit).
